What Is Bitcoin Halving ? Bitcoin halving is an event that reduces the reward miners receive for adding new blocks by 50%. How does it work ? - Happens approximately every four years. - Occurs every 210,000 blocks. - Reduces the rate at which new Bitcoin enters circulation. - Helps Bitcoin maintain its maximum supply of 21 million BTC. The latest halving occurred in April 2024, reducing the block reward from 6.25 BTC to 3.125 BTC. Important: Halving reduces new supply, but it does not guarantee a price increase. Market demand and other factors still matter.
